edges.description: Abnormal matrix remodeling weakens the cerebral arterial wall.

Saccular enlargement of a posterior communicating artery aneurysm can compress the adjacent oculomotor nerve even before rupture.

Rupture causes hemorrhage into the subarachnoid space.

Subarachnoid and intraventricular blood after aneurysm rupture obstructs cerebrospinal fluid circulation and absorption, producing acute hydrocephalus.
